verdict: Against null poles matched on size AND average co-expression, every functional axis exceeds the null nuclear_vs_surface p=0.000, mito_vs_cytoskeleton p=0.023, transcription_vs_transport p=0.017. Against size-matched modules of the MOST co-expressed genes (v2 null b, 3-10x more co-expressed than the functional poles) the axes sit at the upper edge: nuclear_vs_surface p=0.05, mito_vs_cytoskeleton p=0.16, transcription_vs_transport p=0.10. Reading: the functional organisation exceeds what matched co-expression gives, but strongly co-expressed gene modules of the same size can reach the same strength, so co-expression structure is sufficient to produce modulation of this size; the test does not show the organisation is beyond co-expression in general.
